title: FasterHappyGhast
description: Ride your Happy Ghast faster than ever! This Datapack gives it a speed boost when you hop on, making sky travel smooth and fun.
body:
Ever wanted your Happy Ghast to feel like a real flying mount?
This datapack makes your ghast accelerate when you ride it, letting you cruise through the skies faster and slow down when you hop off — perfect for smoother, more fun aerial adventures.
